en.bdb: The sin of apostasy does not get off
If one goes to the Ganges, Yamuna, Godavari and Kurukshetr.
Mathure, Mayapuri, Ayodhya , Kasi, Kedarnath are also visited.
The door of Gomati, Sarasvati, Prayag. Gaya is too approached.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੋਮ ਜਗਿ ਸਭ ਦੇਵ ਜੁਹਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: jap tap sa(n)jam hom jag sabh dhev juhaare|

en.bdb: All sort of rectations, penances, continences, yajns, homs are practised and all the gods are eulogised.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਪਰਣੈ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਅ ਮਝਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: akhee paranai je bhavai tih loa majhaare|

en.bdb: The eyes putting on earth if even the three worlds are visited.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਤਿਆ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit_en: mool na utarai hatiaa bemukh gurdhuaare ||17||

en.bdb: Even then the sin of apostasy never fades out.
